description.p: Jubler is a tool to edit text-based subtitles. It can be used as authoring software for new subtitles or as a tool to convert, transform, correct and refine existing subtitles.

ul.li: Support for multiple subtitle formats: SubRip (SRT), SubStation Alpha (SSA/ASS), SubViewer, MicroDVD, MPL2, and more
Graphical preview with FFmpeg integration for video playback and waveform display
Spell checking with support for multiple dictionaries
Advanced editing tools: split, join, time shift, frame rate conversion
Style support for character and subtitle formatting when using SubStation or SRT formats
Translation mode with parent and child editors for creating translated subtitles
Color marking for subtitles to highlight specific sections
Automatic marking of subtitles exceeding size thresholds
Fix time inconsistencies and overlapping subtitles with optimization algorithms
Support for all Java platform encodings including UTF-8
